messages.高いスキルレベルと大きな最大値でマッチに勝ちにいく斬撃人格。S3「スワッシュ」を: A Slash Identity that seeks clash wins through high skill levels and high maximum Power. Land S3 Swash after winning its clash to inflict 5 Slash Fragility and boost single-target damage next turn. Few Coins make her performance highly dependent on SP.
messages.高いマッチ性能: 全攻撃スキルと守備のスキルレベルが人格Lv+5。S2「アッパー: **Strong Clash performance**: All of her attack skills and her Defense skill have Skill Level Identity Lv +5. S2 Upper Slash is 1 Coin with +12/+14 Coin Power, and S3 is 3 Coins with Clash Power 4–19.
messages.S3の斬撃脆弱: Ⅰコイン的中時に次のターンに斬撃脆弱3を付与し、マッチ勝利時は: **S3's Slash Fragility**: On Coin Ⅰ hit, inflicts 3 Slash Fragility next turn, plus 2 more on Clash Win (5 total). It cannot be inflicted if Coin Ⅰ is broken in the Clash.
messages.S2「アッパースラッシュ」: 対象に斬撃脆弱があればスキル威力+2。マッチ勝利時: **S2 — Upper Slash**: +2 Skill Power if the target has Slash Fragility. Grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn on Clash Win. Coin Ⅰ inflicts 2 Defense Level Down.
messages.バトルパッシブ「はん・われ」(暴食×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): このターンの斬: **Combat passive — C. I. H. (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +10% Slash damage this turn.
messages.サポートパッシブ「アイスブレイク」(暴食×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 最大体力: **Support passive — Ice Breaker (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: +1 to the Rupture inflicted by the 1 ally with the lowest max HP.
messages.精神力が高いうちはS2・S3で積極的にマッチを取る。S3は勝てる相手に当てて斬撃: While her SP is high, actively take Clashes with S2 and S3. Throw S3 at opponents she can beat to aim for 5 Slash Fragility, then press the attack next turn with S2 and Slash allies. S1 and S2 are 1-Coin skills, so her Clashes are unstable early on when SP is low, and her low HP makes her crumble easily. She only inflicts a little Rupture with S1 Slash, so in Rupture teams she can also sit in backup for her support passive.
